_about: A track counts as a priority track only when one of its artists, as listed in the local
metadata (data/metadata/music_metadata.csv, matched by exact Spotify track_id), equals a name
below exactly (case-sensitive). Tracks without local metadata are never treated as priority
tracks. Each name was checked against the tracks it matches in the local metadata on 2026-10-10.
Off by default (it failed the Phase 2K diversity/repeat-rate gates at max_share 0.3, see README).
Switch on with enabled: true or MOODCAST_ARTIST_PRIORITY=1; MOODCAST_ARTIST_PRIORITY=0 always switches it off.

_excluded_names.Jin: the local metadata's 'Jin' is a Japanese Vocaloid producer ('Kagerou Days'), not BTS's Jin
_excluded_names.King: matches both the Indian rapper and a 1980s UK band
_excluded_names.Mukesh: matches the Hindi playback singer and a different Tamil-credit artist
_excluded_names.V: single-letter name; too generic to trust as an exact match (BTS's V is covered by BTS)
_excluded_names.RM: two-letter name; too generic to trust as an exact match (covered by BTS)
_excluded_names.Atif Aslam / Rahat Fateh Ali Khan / Nusr: Pakistani artists, not Indian (often on Bollywood soundtracks); add them here if wanted
